description: trying to imitate 4 seasons but in space
summary: 4Seasons' Earth Information Jukebox is an offline-capable web application that translates climate graphs, satellite maps, and custom images into curated audio tracks. Users can scan through illustrated datasets—including Global Temperature Anomalies, the Keeling Curve, Arctic Sea Ice, Amazon Fires, and Polar Currents—to hear corresponding local MP3 files play one at a time as patterns shift. Built for accessibility, the app features keyboard scrubbing controls and built-in voice guidance, plus a visual heuristic mode that matches uploaded landscape photos to broad environmental soundscapes. We did our best making the sound library but still needs some callibration.
